# A249110: arithmetic-derivative witnesses for terms 1..9.
# i n D(n) D^2(n) D^3(n) D^4(n) D^5(n) D^6(n) D^7(n) D^8(n) root
# n = a(i); root^2 = Sum_{j=0..8} (D^j(n))^2, with D^0(n) = n.
# D is the arithmetic derivative; D(0) = D(1) = 0; zero tails are allowed.
# No further qualifying n occurs through 22000000000; a(10) > 22000000000.
# Project author: Carlo Corti. Date: 2026-10-27.
